mechanic.summary: Orbs travel toward Ziekket; players can intercept them for a temporary damage-and-healing increase coupled with sustained damage.
mechanic.response: Assign healthy players to soak every orb before it reaches the boss, spacing acquisitions so the healer can cover the damage.

provenance.description: Compact tactical classification from Wowhead's Patch 12.1 Blinding Vale guide and linked spell record.
